# HRP Rule 0 - Use common sense Above every other standard, use common sense. Play in a way that a reasonable person would find sensible for the situation your character is in. If something is obviously a bad idea in the world of the game, do not do it just because a rule does not spell it out.
- Do not hunt for loopholes in the wording of a rule. If you have to argue that something is "technically allowed", it probably is not. - Think about how your actions affect the round and the people around you, not just yourself. - When a situation is not covered by a specific rule, ask "what would a sensible person do here?" and act on that. - No ruleset can list every case. Admins judge unlisted situations on common sense, and so should you.
## Examples Acceptable: - Backing off from a fight that has clearly become pointless or one-sided. - Checking that a door you are welding shut is not trapping innocent people inside.
Prohibited: - Doing something obviously destructive and defending it with "no rule says I can't". - Technically following the letter of a rule while clearly breaking its intent.
## HRP rules These HRP rules below are exclusive to Vestige high roleplay servers. They apply during a round in addition to the Roleplay Rules. Where an HRP rule is stricter than a base roleplay rule, the HRP Standard takes precedence.
- [textlink="1. Stay immersed in the world" link="RuleH1"] - [textlink="2. Play a persistent, consistent character" link="RuleH2"] - [textlink="3. Follow high-roleplay escalation" link="RuleH3"]
